added.name: Ilya Sutskever
added.snippet: One of the most highly cited computer scientists in history, he has won the NeurIPS Test of Time Award for his lasting impact on AI research three times in a row (2022-2024) and received the National Academy of Sciences Award for the Industrial Application of Science in 2026. [7][3]

added.name: Nate Soares
added.snippet: Nathaniel Soares is an American artificial intelligence author and researcher known for his work on existential risk from AI. [1][2] In 2014, Soares co-authored a paper that introduced the term AI alignment, the challenge of making increasingly capable AIs behave as intended.
